title: HoldingAndUsingPostedCollateralElection
description: A class to specify the parties' elections related to the holding and using of posted collateral.

eligibilityToHoldCollateral.description: The specification of the conditions under which a party and its custodian(s) are entitled to hold posted collateral.

useOfPostedCollateral.description: Specifies whether the party to the agreement has the right to rehypothecate the collateral held (True).
